_comment: Mirrors Umbraco Cloud production specs as of 2026-05. Cloud runs all plans on shared P1V3 App Service hardware (2 CPU / 8 GB RAM / 250 GB disk) and differentiates plans via per-site CPU/memory/disk quotas - quotas we can't replicate on dedicated plans, so our Starter app-side results will read more optimistic than real Cloud Starter. SQL is reproducible: Cloud uses Standard-tier Elastic Pools with a tier-specific per-DB DTU cap (Starter=20, Standard=50, Pro=100). DB size is not enforced. We provision one pool per tier in use; the pool's eDTU capacity is the smallest valid Standard size that can hold a DB at the cap (Starter+Standard share a 50-eDTU pool, Pro uses a 100-eDTU pool); per-DB max DTU is set to the tier cap.
